importantQualifications.qualification: Evaluate/Skip labels preserve the complete protected LTR row and are natural Hebrew wrappers, not complete explanations of all dispatcher semantics. Required/requisite/sufficient/optional and include/substack distinctions are assessed using actual supporting glossary and listed explanatory/runtime contexts. Raw row/body bytes are not artificially translated. No algorithm/model reevaluation performed.

Native include/substack tree heading and numeric-jump/substack-row contexts do not claim long include-inline runtime prose. Actual Hebrew glossary states matching-module-type inclusion in enclosing stack versus bounded substack done/die/jumps and parent counts-one semantics.

Runtime examples distinguish unavailability, unknown kid and unknown critical parameter. Unsupported-as-not-necessarily-invalid is actually present and reviewed in Hebrew glossary; this sample does not claim nonexistent long runtime unsupported explanation.

The different-administrator credential prompt artifact label is wholly protected. Its unchanged English is formal identity, not Hebrew prose coverage or proof of human comprehension. Consent-versus-credential conceptual meaning was separately assessed from actual paired native explanations/glossary.
Four outcomes are retained as exact literal enums, with distinct actual glossary meanings. Missing transport/notchecked remains separate. No DNS transport/runtime/browser testing was performed.
